# LOCK IN · trailer-load.com

> LOCK IN is a free, browser-based warehouse trailer-loading training simulator. It plays like Tetris but models the real job: load integrity, weight and balance, hazmat segregation, non-conveyables, a dispatch clock, and safety incidents scored the way a dock supervisor would call them. Built by F-Keys Creative LLC (Operations President: Vince Gonzalez). Free forever for workers and students, with no player accounts. Instructors make crews on a dashboard; a crew of up to 9 is free, and a license (unlimited crews, CSV export, a data agreement) is the paid product for CTE programs, trade schools, and warehouse employers.

## Play
- [LOCK IN · the simulator](https://trailer-load.com/lock-in.html): The full trailer-loading simulator. Free, no account. Modes: Training, Trailer-Load, Daily. Public boards take three initials. Scored on integrity, density, pace, and safety; ranked Rookie to Yard Legend.

## For schools & employers
- [Program & Funding Overview](https://trailer-load.com/for-districts/program-overview.html): Pricing ($1,950/yr site license, $1,450 founding/multi-campus, $29/student/semester, $490/yr employer bay, $4,999 custom edition), purchasing routes, and Perkins V allowability notes.
- [Technical & Compliance Documentation](https://trailer-load.com/for-districts/): What the product stores, what it never collects, how joining a crew works, accessibility posture, and what a district IT review needs to sign off.
- [Instructor Dashboard](https://trailer-load.com/dashboard/): Instructors make crews and give out a join code. Each crew member's load integrity (attention to detail), completed walls (follow-through), throughput (pieces/hour), and safety incidents. CSV export with a license. Built for CTE (Perkins-eligible as instructional software under Perkins V Sec. 135(b)(5)(D); the state CTE agency makes the final call), trade schools, and warehouse ops teams.
- [Home / overview](https://trailer-load.com/): What LOCK IN is, how it works, and the free-for-workers / paid-dashboard-for-facilities model.

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://trailer-load.com/privacy.html): How board initials, crews, instructor accounts, and student/minor data (FERPA-aware) are handled. There are no player accounts.
- [Terms of Service](https://trailer-load.com/terms.html): Free use, facility dashboards, acceptable use, and disclaimers.

## About
LOCK IN is a training *supplement* · it builds loading intuition and tracks practice progress. It does NOT replace employer safety training, OSHA training, or any certification requirement. Made by F-Keys Creative LLC, a Florida limited liability company (https://www.f-keys.com/). Operations President: Vince Gonzalez.
